name: web-dark-vertical-collapsible-sidebar-navigation-states-on-gradient
title: Collapsible Dark Sidebar States on Gradient
whatItIs: Five black vertical sidebar states on a purple-to-mint gradient: a collapsed icon rail, one with a flyout submenu on hover, one with a profile pill expanding from the avatar, and two expanded with a white Admin panel of grouped links with an active blue item and an Expand Navigation tooltip.
whatItMeans: Showing each state in order documents the interaction, and the vivid gradient makes the dark rail pop.
techniques: Rail that expands into a white panel
Hover flyout submenu on an icon
Profile pill sliding out of the avatar
Grouped nav sections with small caps headings

vocabulary.definition: A narrow vertical bar of icons.
A submenu that appears beside an item on hover.
The widened version of a collapsed navigation.
